heading.info: First line. Leave both heading lines empty to use the default text, which is already translated into every store language.

heading_highlight.label: Highlighted line
heading_highlight.info: Second line, in the accent color.

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/football, or to all products until it exists.

secondary_button_link.info: Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/basketball, or to all products until it exists.

season.label: Outlined text behind the images
season.info: For example the season, 26/27. Leave empty to hide it.

image_1.label: Product image 1
image_1.info: A product photo with a transparent background (PNG), about 1000 × 1000 px. Until you add one, two drawn kits are shown on the circle.

image.info: A landscape photo, at least 2000 px wide.

overlay_opacity.label: Overlay strength
overlay_opacity.info: Shades the photo behind the text so it stays readable.

image_ltr.label: Image for left-to-right languages (English)
image_ltr.info: Optional. A desktop photo with the people on the right, since the text sits on the left in English. When set, mirroring is off.

mirror_ltr.label: Mirror the photo in left-to-right languages
mirror_ltr.info: Photos are composed for Hebrew: people on the left, text on the right. In English the text moves to the left, and mirroring keeps the people on the other side. Don't use it for photos with text or logos.

info.content: Up to 4 benefits. A benefit with empty text uses the default text for its position (delivery, returns, stock in Israel, secure payment), already translated into every store language.

text.info: Leave empty to use the default text for this position.

collection.info: The link shows the collection's name, translated with the collection.

label.label: Label
label.info: Leave empty to use the collection's name.

link.info: Optional. Use it to link somewhere other than the collection.

featured.label: Highlight
featured.info: Shows this link in inverted colors.

heading.info: Leave empty to use the collection's name, which is translated with the collection.

audience.label: Show
audience.info: Adults and kids are told apart by the product tag audience:kids.

one_per_team.label: One product per team
one_per_team.info: Shows only the first product of each team, so the row shows more teams.

mobile_scroller.label: Swipe on mobile
mobile_scroller.info: Shows the products in one row that customers swipe through, instead of a grid.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: A scrolling row shows the products in one row that scrolls sideways, with arrows on desktop.

source.label: Products from
source.info: A product page can show more of the product's league (without its own team, in the product's audience); a team's collection page can show more of the team's league.

copy.label: Eyebrow and text
copy.info: Ready-made texts, already translated into every store language. Your own texts below replace them.

intro_card.label: Opening card
intro_card.info: An accent-colored card before the products, with the eyebrow, heading, text and a "view all" button.

product_type.label: Product type
product_type.info: Shows only products of this type, for example only the jerseys of a collection that also holds shorts.

lazy_render.label: Load when the visitor scrolls near it
lazy_render.info: From the fourth section of a page on, the section loads when the visitor gets close to it, so long pages open fast. It always shows in the theme editor.

button_link.info: The link under the sets. Leave empty to link to all products.

info.content: A jersey and the shorts of the same team, bought together. With more than one set, team tabs switch between them; a tab takes the name of the jersey's team category. A set whose jersey or shorts is sold out is hidden.

image.info: A product photo or a lifestyle photo. Without an image, a jersey illustration is shown.

options.contain: Fit (the whole product on a light background)
options.cover: Fill (crops the photo to fill the area)

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to all products.
Leave empty to link to the collection whose URL ends in /collections/kids, or to all products until it exists.

secondary_link.label: Size guide link
secondary_link.info: Leave empty to open the kids' table on the page whose URL ends in /pages/size-guide. If that page doesn't exist, the link is hidden.

size_code.label: Size
size_code.info: As the kids products name it, for example 16. The age and height below show under it.

title.label: Age
title.info: The ages this size fits, for example 2-3. Without a size, the age becomes the tile's main label and the word "years" is added.

height_cm.label: Height (cm)
height_cm.info: The child's height for this size, a number or a range such as 95-105. Leave empty to hide it.

button_link.info: Leave empty to open a WhatsApp chat with the number in Theme settings > Business details. If both are empty, the button is hidden.
The button is shown only when it has a link.

image.info: Portrait photo (4:5). Without one, the collection's image shows.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: A collection without products isn't shown on the storefront.

page.label: Page
page.info: Instead of a collection, e.g. team orders. The title comes from the page's title.

title.label: Title
title.info: Leave empty to use the collection's or page's title.

link.label: Other link
link.info: Only when no collection or page is chosen.

button_link.info: Leave empty to link to all products.

product.label: Product in the photo
product.info: Shows a tag with the product, its price and a link, and the whole photo leads to it.

link.info: Where the photo leads when no product is chosen.

image.label: Desktop image
image.info: A wide photo in 3:1, such as 3840 × 1280 px. The people stand in the left 40%, with their heads in the top fifth; the text sits on the right.

image_mobile.info: A tall photo, such as 1088 × 1408 px. The people fill the upper half; the text sits over the lower half. Without one, the desktop photo is cropped.

copy.label: Ready-made text
copy.info: Text already translated into every store language. Anything you type in the fields below replaces it.

text_side.label: Text side
text_side.info: Automatic puts the text at the start of the reading direction (right in Hebrew and Arabic, left in English). Choose a side when the photo's people stand on the other side and the photo can't be mirrored.

copy.label: Texts
copy.info: Ready-made eyebrow, heading and text, already translated into every store language. Your own texts below replace them.

link.info: Where the link next to the arrows goes, for example the players collection.

image.label: Card picture
image.info: A cut-out jersey on a transparent background (PNG). Empty: the collection's "Card picture" field, else a photo of its first jersey.

color.label: Card color
color.info: Lights the card. Empty: the collection's "Card color" field, else the accent color.

mark.label: Big number or letters
mark.info: Shown large behind the jersey: a player's number or a team's short code, such as 24 or RMA. Empty: the collection's "Card number" field.

copy.label: Texts
copy.info: Ready-made eyebrow, heading and text, already translated into every store language. Your own texts below replace them.
